What the Photos Show

Documented, Not Assumed

Lace, decorative construction and layered fabrics need item-specific evaluation. The full-gown and detail views help document visible condition changes, but the photographs do not establish which treatments were used or how long the work took.

These are original ACR job photographs. The comparison shows observable differences; it does not establish the incident location, cleaning chemicals, turnaround time, insurance settlement, or a guaranteed outcome for other items.

Restoration depends on the item, material, damage, contamination and individual assessment. These photos are a record of the pictured items, not a promise of identical results.
